name: zsnd_stream_request_state_play_current_entry
description: zSndStreamRequest::StatePlayCurrentEntry advances due stream entries, resolves non-NULL samples, preserves the 0xffff play-count sentinel, and transitions into repeat or termination states.
known_limits: tier S verification remains open for the stream request state-machine cluster. Functional coverage exercises the recovered branch behavior through the active update predicate.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a4ea0 validates elapsed-time accumulation, per-entry delay gating, inline sample-name comparison against "NULL", zSnd::FindSampleByName use, cached-sample playback dispatch, signed play-count decrement, child-entry advance, repeat-index handling, and termination-delay transition.

The native smoke verifies a cached sample is resolved for a non-NULL entry, the nested NULL entry keeps the 0xffff sentinel, the request advances to repeat delay after exhausting entries, and the same request later transitions to termination delay.
